positive_change.result: L'installation de poubelles connectées et autonomes réduit la fréquence des collectes et évite les débordements dans les zones touristiques de Tokyo.
positive_change.beneficiaries: habitants, touristes, et équipes de nettoyage des quartiers très fréquentés de Tokyo et Kyoto

fact_checks.sentence: Au Japon, la rareté traditionnelle des poubelles publiques a posé des difficultés aux touristes, tandis que les municipalités évitaient d'en installer pour limiter les débordements et coûts liés à la collecte.
source_passages: If you’ve ever visited Japan, you too may have been left confused and eventually frustrated by what appears to be a total absence of public waste bins.
This is by design.
Officials concerned about security and overflowing bins have left the public with few places to dispose of their trash.
There is also a philosophy that if waste is difficult to dispose of, people will be less prone to creating it.
Japanese tourism authorities are beginning to understand that, while this approach may have seen citizens keep their streets clean for decades, it’s a major inconvenience for visitors.
Yet the trend towards removing waste bins has continued, with the Tokyo metro removing all public waste bins as recently as 2022.
Another reason why cities like Kyoto and Tokyo decided to trash their trash cans was that they fill up too quickly in busy areas, and collection of each bin was an expensive outlay.

fact_checks.sentence: Tokyo innove désormais avec des poubelles solaires dotées d’un compacteur automatique qui réduit le volume des déchets toutes les 5 minutes, permettant de contenir jusqu’à cinq fois plus que des poubelles classiques.
source_passages: In parallel, however, the city has been enlisting the help of various firms to design smarter waste bins that hold more and won’t overflow.
One example is Forcetec, which sells and installs solar-powered waste bins developed in the United States called SmaGO.
It compacts waste every 5 minutes and can hold 5 times as much trash as a non-compacting bin.

fact_checks.sentence: Ces poubelles sont connectées, indiquant en temps réel leur niveau de remplissage, ce qui optimise la fréquence des collectes.
source_passages: “There are many places that recognize the need for trash bins but hesitate to install them because they’re worried the bins will overflow or because of the labor required to collect the rubbish,” says Rina Ogata, a spokesperson for Forcetec.
“You can install SmaGO and reduce the frequency of rubbish collection.

The communications function also allows operators to check online how full each bin is, so they can make collections more efficiently before the bins reach capacity.” Companies like Forcetec have donated or subsidized these products as part of “a corporate hometown tax program” and “corporate sponsorships” according to Japan Times.

fact_checks.sentence: Par ailleurs, des poubelles robotisées équipées de capteurs roulent automatiquement vers des points de collecte autonomes quand elles sont pleines.
source_passages: Enter California-based firm Cartken, whose 40-liter robotic trash bins use sensors to measure when they’re almost full, at which point they drive themselves out of the public reach for emptying.

positive_change.result: La croissance progressive des récifs coralliens grâce à la formation continue de squelettes en carbonate de calcium par les polypes coralliens.
positive_change.beneficiaries: Les récifs coralliens eux-mêmes, ainsi que les écosystèmes marins qui dépendent de ces structures.

fact_checks.sentence: Les récifs coralliens se développent par l'accumulation successive de squelettes en carbonate de calcium formés par des organismes appelés polypes coralliens.
source_passages: A coral reef is made of thin layers of calcium carbonate Coral polyps form a living mat over a calcium carbonate skeleton.
Stony corals (or scleractinians) are the corals primarily responsible for laying the foundations of, and building up, reef structures.
Massive reef structures are formed when each individual stony coral organism—or polyp—secretes a skeleton of calcium carbonate.

fact_checks.sentence: Chaque polype sécrète un petit squelette calcaire sur lequel il vit, et les colonies se multiplient en construisant sur les restes calcaires de générations antérieures.
source_passages: Massive reef structures are formed when each individual stony coral organism—or polyp—secretes a skeleton of calcium carbonate.
These colonies consist of millions of polyps that grow on top of the limestone remains of former colonies, eventually forming massive reefs.

fact_checks.sentence: Ces structures peuvent prendre beaucoup d'ampleur au fil des années, croissant lentement, généralement de 0,5 à 2 cm par an, mais parfois plus rapidement sous de bonnes conditions comme la lumière abondante et une température stable.
source_passages: In general, massive corals tend to grow slowly, increasing in size from 0.5 to two centimeters (0.2 to 0.8 inches) per year.
However, under favorable conditions (lots of light, consistent temperature, moderate wave action), some species can grow as much as 4.5 centimeters (1.8 inches) per year.
